item.title: Life, Death & Mario Kart [1008] A Rambling Challenge 🗣️
item.description: Join me for a completely spontaneous "rambling challenge" in which I attempt to talk without stopping for at least 45 minutes. I end up discussing the benefits of talking to yourself for English fluency, the ideas of "practice makes perfect" and "practice makes permanent", the best advice Tom Hiddleston ever got, what it means to "seize the day", how thinking about death is life affirming, Dr Kawashima's Brain Training, and a nostalgia trip about Super Mario Kart on the Nintendo. • Luke's event at the British Council 👉 https://www.britishcouncil.fr/en/events/talks-english-scary-stories-unexplained-mysteries • Get the PDF transcript 👉 https://teacherluke.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Life-Death-Mario-Kart-A-Rambling-Challenge-1008-Episode-Transcript.pdf • Episode page 👉 https://teacherluke.co.uk/2026/11/04/life-death-mario-kart-1008-a-rambling-challenge-🗣️/ • LEP Premium 👉 https://teacherluke.co.uk/premium Hosted on Acast. item.title: A Big Talk about Small Talk 🗣️ (with Ray Addam) Improve your Speaking Skills in English [1007]
item.description: Small talk is not just a pointless way to fill silence in social situations, it is an opportunity to make great social connections, build your network and just have an interesting conversation with someone new, but how do we do it successfully? How can you develop your confidence, and take the right approach to making good connections with people you meet? That’s what this episode is all about, as I am joined again by Ray Addam, who has plenty of good advice and stories to share. item.title: 9 True Ghost Stories & Unexplained Mysteries from Listeners 👀🕯️ LEPster Writing Competition [1006]
item.description: Listen to a selection of 9 fascinating stories written by listeners, one of which will win the competition which I launched earlier this year. Finally, the wait is over and the creepy story competition episode is here. I had to work very hard to narrow down the entries from 74 to only 9. Anna Brooke and I chose our favourite, as you will hear. These are extremely mysterious and extraordinary stories sent in by my listeners. They describe very bizarre and spooky experiences, often involving the sad loss of a family member, spirits from the past searching for peace, or just disturbing coincidences that are hard to reconcile. All 74 stories are available to read on the episode PDF, and there are plenty of very interesting entries there too. Thank you to everyone who sent a story, and congratulations to the winner, who will win a copy of Anna Brooke's "Death by Chocolate". Get the episode PDF 👉 https://teacherluke.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/True-Ghost-Stories-Unexplained-Mysteries-fr

item.title: Sir David Attenborough 🌍 Britain's #1 National Treasure [1005]
item.description: This episode is a celebration of a living-legend of British life & culture - Sir David Attenborough, who is best known for making documentaries on the BBC about the natural world. Listen as I give an overview of his life and career, explain why he is so loved by people, share anecdotes from people who have met him, describe memorable animal moments from his documentaries, and do a few impressions of his distinctive voice.
